description: Until January 1, 2027: put a brand on a billboard or a tower window on floors 1 to 40 for free, no card (one per person and one per website). The ad is checked now; a refused ad goes nowhere. Then the person gets an email, and the spot lights when they press Confirm (the link works for 24 hours). Returns leaseId with status awaiting_confirmation: follow it with check_lease. After January 1 the spot goes dark unless they keep it at the monthly price.

brandName.description: Shown on the window; taken from the website when left out

brandUrl.description: The brand's website (https; a bare domain gets https:// added)

email.description: The person's email: the confirm link goes there, and the spot is theirs

logoUrl.description: A logo or banner image (https); the website's share image is used when left out

pitch.description: One line under the name; taken from the website when left out

windowId.description: A slot from find_windows with freeOffer: true, e.g. "F12-S3" or "B-1234"

name: claim_free_spot

expiresAt.description: When the confirm link stops working (UTC)

freeUntil.description: When the free time ends (UTC); then it's renewPrice a month if kept, or it goes dark

title: Claim a free spot
